scope: Synthetic demonstration only. Sanitized mail summary, app-grant inventory and one manifest; no real accounts accessed.
summary: Review the broad write grant first. The old email is only an account candidate, and dependency risk needs resolved versions. Key coverage is blocked.
next_step: Have the owner decide whether Example Sync needs all-repository write access, then obtain the minimum metadata needed for a scoped change proposal.

coverage.detail: Fixture mail-summary-01 covers one old welcome message; account existence and usage not verified.
Fixture grant-export-01 reviewed in full; one invented grant, observed 2026-11-05.
No metadata-only inventory supplied; no credential files opened.
Fixture manifest-01 has a version range but no lockfile; no external advisory query or package execution.

findings.evidence: mail-summary-01 row 1: welcome email dated 2021-04-12. Inference: possible forgotten account; not evidence of last login or present account existence.
findings.impact: Possible retained account/data; no sensitive permissions or current use established. Age alone does not establish risk.
findings.action: Verify account existence and current need through the independently opened official account page.
findings.retest: Owner confirms account status and required data retention; record dated metadata only.

findings.evidence: grant-export-01 row 1 explicitly shows all-repository write access. Last-used field is absent; inactivity is unknown.
findings.impact: Broad write access could affect multiple projects if the integration is compromised; necessity is not established.
findings.action: Confirm which workflows depend on the grant and whether repository-scoped access is sufficient; propose a change for owner review.
findings.retest: Dated grant metadata and owner decision establish required scope; any change verified in a separately authorized task.

findings.evidence: manifest-01 declares a development dependency range. No resolved version or current advisory evidence supplied.
findings.impact: Version-specific vulnerability status cannot be established; build dependencies remain in scope.
findings.action: Provide a sanitized lockfile-derived inventory, including development and transitive packages, before any advisory comparison.
findings.retest: Exact package versions and dated official advisory evidence establish applicability without executing the project.

limitations: All records are invented fixtures; this demonstrates report formatting, not an actual security audit.
No credentials read or tested, no live account settings inspected, no network vulnerability scans, no code execution or remediation.
Missing evidence does not establish safety; historical email does not establish current account usage.
